occasions.title: Birthday
occasions.description: Warm wishes for their special day

greetings.text: Wishing you a wonderful birthday filled with love, laughter, and beautiful memories.
May your new year of life bring happiness, good health, and dreams come true.

occasions.title: Friendship
occasions.description: Celebrate the friends who make life brighter

greetings.text: Life is brighter and every memory is better because I have a friend like you.
Real friendship turns ordinary days into unforgettable memories.
May this festive season bring peace to your home, joy to your heart, and hope for the days ahead.
Wishing you and your family happiness, prosperity, and togetherness.
